from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAPRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial record extracted from a single document regarding accounts payable."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name found in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the AP line item (e.g., 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable and accrued expenses')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the accounts payable figure")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the value (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    ap_records: list[CompanyAPRecord]
